name: Deadbolts

specs.label: Deadbolt throw
specs.value: 25mm, zinc die-cast with hardened steel roller insert

specs.label: Cylinder
specs.value: 5-pin tumbler, solid brass plug, two nickel-plated brass keys

specs.label: Handing
specs.value: Fully reversible, left or right hand

specs.label: Feature
specs.value: Free-turning cylinder trim prevents wrenching; cylinder removable for rekeying

specs.label: Keying
specs.value: Can be keyed to pair with an entrance bored lock

seoDescription: Canton Hyland D101 DSPB deadbolts. A stainless steel deadbolt, single cylinder function, for entrance doors. Manufactured in Guangdong, China. Request a quotation.

specsEs.label: Salida del cerrojo
specsEs.value: 25 mm, de zamak inyectado con rodillo de acero templado

specsEs.label: Cilindro
specsEs.value: Cilindro de 5 pines con núcleo de latón macizo y dos llaves de latón niqueladas

specsEs.label: Característica
specsEs.value: La guarnición giratoria del cilindro impide el arranque; cilindro extraíble para recodificar

specsEs.label: Amaestramiento
specsEs.value: Admite llave igual con una cerradura de entrada de perforación
